description: Four crawlers wander through a field of fixed points, sending a gate and a pitch each time one comes close enough to a point to connect

params.text: Sets how fast the crawlers move
Sets how close a crawler has to come to a point to connect to it
Sets how many fixed points there are in the field
Lays out a fresh set of points and crawlers
Sets how wide a spread of pitches the field covers, 0V to 5V
Sets how far a crawler is allowed to stray from where it started
At the bottom of its travel a crawler staggers about, and at the top it moves in a straight line

inputs.text: Each trigger here moves the crawlers on one step
A trigger here lays out a fresh set of points and crawlers
Added to the connection distance knob
Added to the wander radius knob
Added to the movement coherence knob

outputs.text: A gate for each crawler, a channel each, high while that crawler is connected to a point
A pitch for each crawler, a channel each, taken from how high up the field its point is
How far across the field each crawler is, a channel each
How far down the field each crawler is, a channel each
How far each crawler is from its nearest point, a channel each, 0V to 10V

notes: double-clicking the field adds a point, and double-clicking a point removes it
menu: Regenerate points & crawlers — lays out a fresh set of points and crawlers
Enable pitch quantization — snaps the pitch outputs to a root and a scale
Root note — sets the root the pitches are snapped to while pitch quantization is on
Scale — sets the scale the pitches are snapped to while pitch quantization is on

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
